statements: This is a long piece of work on the shop service. Do the milestones in order and keep everything working as you go. The decisions below are binding on all of them, including the last.
Decision A: from milestone 1 on, money is whole cents in integers everywhere. No function takes or returns fractional amounts.
Decision B: from milestone 1 on, any function you add that can fail returns { ok: false, error: { code } } and never throws for a business failure. On success it returns { ok: true, value }.
Decision C: every operation you add that changes state appends one entry to store.audit, shaped { type, at }, plus the ids involved, where at comes from store.clock().
Decision D: no new dependencies, and src/legacy/ must not change, because another team owns it.
Milestone 1: change src/catalog.mjs and src/cart.mjs to integer cents, so a product's price and cartTotal(store, cart) are in cents. Existing tests in test/ show the current behaviour to convert.

Milestone 2: add placeOrder(store, cart, customerId) in src/orders.mjs. It takes stock with takeStock from src/inventory.mjs, charges through src/payments.mjs chargeCard(store, customerId, amount), and returns the order { id, customerId, lines, total, status: 'paid' }. If stock or payment fails, nothing is left changed.

Milestone 3: add coupons in src/coupons.mjs. addCoupon(store, { code, percent, expiresAt }) saves one. placeOrder gains an optional coupon code, and the discount rounds down to whole cents. An unknown or expired coupon fails the order with code bad_coupon. A coupon works up to and including expiresAt.

Milestone 4: add refundOrder(store, orderId, amount) in src/refunds.mjs. Partial refunds are allowed, up to the amount paid across all refunds; beyond that fails with refund_too_large. Refunds return stock only when an order is fully refunded. Status becomes partially_refunded or refunded.

Milestone 5: add reserveStock(store, sku, qty, customerId) and placeOrder's use of it in src/inventory.mjs. A reservation holds stock for 15 minutes from store.clock(), in milliseconds. Other customers cannot take reserved stock, and an order by the same customer uses their reservation first. An expired reservation holds nothing.

Milestone 6: add monthlyStatement(store, year, month) in src/statements.mjs, returning { orders, gross, refunds, net } for orders placed in that UTC month, with refunds counted in the month they happen. Add a test for each milestone in test/, and describe the decisions in the README.
brief: Carry out the numbered milestones on the shop service in order. The decisions are binding throughout. Follow the conventions already in the code.
